Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Moreno Valley for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The season brings Santa visits at Moreno Valley Mall (November 27 to December 24), a big Saturday on December 5 with the Holiday Snow Day and the free Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony, and Menifee's Breakfast with Santa (December 12). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Moreno Valley

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Moreno Valley and Menifee
  • 2 free events: the Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony and Santa visits at Moreno Valley Mall

  • Parades and tree lightings: the Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Hall (December 5)
  • Snow: the Holiday Snow Day with real snow and sled runs (December 5)
  • Season: November 27 to December 24
